thought.text: Now install web frontend dependencies and start the dev server.

reasoning_content:
Now run npm ci in web_application and then npm run dev. Let me start npm ci first (could take a while). Let me run it in background inside container.

Actually let me also fix the docker web_application service so it works (a documented access point at port 3003). But the compose file build doesn't pass env args for the web app. The .env.local.example in web_application—but the Dockerfile copies web_application/ which includes .env.local only if present. Since I just created .env.local now, rebuilding the web image would include it. Let me do that later; first the tooling npm ci and dev.

Let me run npm ci in background in container.

action.command: cd /workspace && nohup docker compose exec -T tooling bash -lc 'cd web_application && npm ci' > /tmp/web_npmci.log 2>&1 & echo "pid $!"; sleep 60; tail -8 /tmp/web_npmci.log; pgrep -f "npm ci" >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo DONE

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && nohup docker compose exec -T tooling bash -lc 'cd web_application && npm ci' > /tmp/web_npmci.log 2>&1 & echo \"pid $!\"; sleep 60; tail -8 /tmp/web_npmci.log; pgrep -f \"npm ci\" >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo DONE", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Run web npm ci in background"}

summary: Run web npm ci in background
